title: Tamsin's approval banter says 'You've earned my back in a fight. That's not a small thing, coming from me' despite the player never having fought anything with her (every hostile encounter this run was talked past or avoided) - the approval trigger appears to fire from accumulated standing rather than any shared combat, so the line rings false for a no-violence playthrough.
where: The Captain-General's Hall (Wardmoor) / ambient companion approval
